name: Magical Traps (Su)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents.

Benefit: The rogue gains a +2 bonus to Perception and Disable Device checks made to find and disarm traps, and may disarm magical traps as if she had the trapfinding class feature.
